decisions.reason: After roughly three years, the men’s coffee-based line has had enough time to reveal its demand potential, and with no later website evidence beyond launch, its niche fit and extra assortment complexity make abandonment the more option-consistent choice.

As a close extension of the existing Sandorini skincare line, the cleansing foam likely has lower ongoing cost and strategic risk, so with limited negative evidence it remains a worthwhile option to keep in the core assortment.
